Content: SemanticToolQualityTests validates project-wiki semantic and hybrid relevance probes, aggregate MRR, deterministic search ordering, MCP tool schema exposure, useful tool output, source_bundle resolution, find_by_source mappings, and JSON-RPC batch notification behavior. MemoryApplicationServiceTests adds CI-safe fake-provider coverage for the embedding ranker so tests do not require a local ONNX model. The quality thresholds still run against the token fallback unless model assets are explicitly configured in the test environment.
Title: Semantic and MCP tool quality tests
